en: Wow. Hi, everyone.
zh: 哇。大家好。

en: So, I'm going to be honest.
zh: 那我就实话实说了。

en: I did not prep a speech for the award.
zh: 我没有为这个奖准备获奖感言。

en: And so if you look behind you, all the screens are black.
zh: 所以如果你们看看身后，所有屏幕都是黑的。

en: And the reason that I did that was because.
zh: 我这么做的原因是，

en: even though all of you are dressed to the nines, and all of you are leaders in your respective industries.
zh: 尽管今晚你们都盛装出席，也都是各自行业里的领军人物，

en: I think of this evening as more than just an awards show.
zh: 但我觉得今晚不只是一个颁奖典礼。

en: I think of it as a homecoming.
zh: 我更觉得它像是一场回家团聚。

en: And when you come home, you sit down, you eat good food,
zh: 而当你回到家，你会坐下来，吃点好吃的，

en: you yap with the family.
zh: 和家人聊个不停。

en: and more than anything, you speak from the heart.
zh: 而最重要的是，你会说出心里话。

en: So that's what I'm going to do.
zh: 所以我今天也打算这么做。

en: So, when I think about impact and the change that you affect going into the future,
zh: 所以，当我想到影响力，以及你们面向未来所带来的改变时，

en: I think it's inextricable from the history we inherit from the past.
zh: 我觉得这和我们从过去继承而来的历史密不可分。

en: My history is very special.
zh: 我的历史非常特别。

en: I come from a lineage of incredibly powerful women.
zh: 我来自一个由无比强大的女性组成的家族。

en: My grandmother, who is smiling at us from above.
zh: 我的外婆，此刻一定正在天上对我们微笑。

en: and also telling me to stand up straight.
zh: 同时也在提醒我站直一点。

en: And my mom, who's smiling at me from the front row tonight.
zh: 还有我的妈妈，今晚正坐在第一排对我微笑。

en: She is the most beautiful woman I have ever met.
zh: 她是我见过的最美丽的女人。

en: because her radiance comes from within.
zh: 因为她的光芒来自内在。

en: And that is the kind of thing that you cannot get at the drugstore.
zh: 而这种东西，是你在药妆店买不到的。

en: She has inspired me in more ways than I can possibly imagine.
zh: 她以我难以想象的各种方式激励着我。

en: And I will tell you a short story.
zh: 我想给你们讲一个小故事。

en: When my mom was my age, she defined success, I kid you not,
zh: 当我妈妈像我现在这么大的时候，她对成功的定义，我真的没开玩笑，

en: as being able to eat a sweet potato every single day.
zh: 就是每天都能吃上一个红薯。

en: That was like made it.
zh: 那对她来说就已经是成功了。

en: That was like the Gold House Gala.
zh: 那就像是她的 Gold House Gala。

en: She can have a sweet potato every day.
zh: 她每天都能吃一个红薯。

en: And so I invite you all, as people who have made it,
zh: 所以我想邀请在座各位，作为已经获得成功的人，

en: to think back five years, ten years, fifteen years.
zh: 回想五年前、十年前、十五年前的自己。

en: What was your sweet potato?
zh: 你们的红薯是什么？

en: What was one goal that you thought would be impossible to reach and
zh: 有没有一个目标，是你曾经觉得根本不可能实现的，

en: once you got it, you would have absolute joy?
zh: 但只要实现了，你就会获得绝对的快乐？

en: I'm sure we all have something like that.
zh: 我相信我们每个人都有这样的东西。

en: For me, it was 2022.
zh: 对我来说，那是在 2022 年。

en: I thought that if I won the Olympics, I would be happy forever.
zh: 我当时以为，如果我赢得奥运会，我就会永远快乐。

en: And things would just be, you know, I'd be living in a fairy tale for the rest of my life.
zh: 然后一切都会像童话一样，你懂的，我会在余生都活在童话里。

en: And after the Olympics, I went through a very tough time when I realized
zh: 但奥运会结束后，我经历了一段非常艰难的时期，因为我意识到，

en: that that actually wasn't true.
zh: 事实其实并不是这样。

en: That life goes on.
zh: 生活还是会继续。

en: And so this very popular phenomenon called the post-Olympic blues hit me very hard.
zh: 于是这种很常见的现象，叫作“奥运后低谷”，狠狠地击中了我。

en: And in that time, I was reflecting on impact and mission.
zh: 在那段时间里，我一直在反思影响力和使命。

en: And I was thinking about joy.
zh: 我也在思考快乐。

en: So in psychology, there's this idea of the hedonic treadmill.
zh: 在心理学里，有一个概念叫“享乐跑步机”。

en: This idea essentially says that we acclimate to success and joy very quickly.
zh: 这个概念本质上是说，我们会很快适应成功和快乐。

en: So when you reach that goal.
zh: 所以当你实现那个目标时，

en: the joy doesn't last as long as you think it does.
zh: 那种快乐并不会像你以为的那样持续那么久。

en: And so chasing that high.
zh: 于是为了追逐那种高峰感，

en: you keep going and you end up disappointed for most of the time.
zh: 你会不断向前，最后大部分时间都陷入失望。

en: Tonight, surrounded by community, love, joy.
zh: 而今晚，被社群、爱与快乐包围着，

en: and that kind of gratitude that only an event like this can inspire,
zh: 还有这种只有像今晚这样的活动才能激发出来的感恩，

en: I propose a new cycle.
zh: 我想提出一个新的循环。

en: We can call it the Impact Cycle or the Gold House Cycle working title.
zh: 我们可以叫它“影响力循环”，或者“Gold House 循环”，暂定名。

en: So here it is.
zh: 那么它是这样的。

en: Here are the two points.
zh: 这里有两个要点。

en: The first one is gratitude.
zh: 第一点是感恩。

en: When you reach a certain point.
zh: 当你走到某个阶段时，

en: what is most important is to think about your sweet potato and take a long,
zh: 最重要的是想一想你的那颗红薯，然后慢慢地、

en: solid, savoring bite of it and think about how much you wanted it.
zh: 踏踏实实地咬上一口，细细品味，并想想你曾经有多渴望它。

en: And secondly, to think about who enabled you to get here.
zh: 第二点，是去想想是谁帮助你走到了这里。

en: Think about the community members, the giants whose shoulders you stand on.
zh: 想想那些社群成员，想想那些让你站在他们肩膀上的巨人。

en: For me, it's my mom and also members of the community like Miss Mickey Lee,
zh: 对我来说，是我的妈妈，也包括像 Miss Mickey Lee 这样的社群成员，

en: who's sitting here in the front row as well.
zh: 她今晚也坐在前排。

en: who have so selflessly uplifted so many members of the Asian community into the limelight
zh: 她们如此无私地把许多亚裔社群成员推向聚光灯下，

en: so that they can hopefully reach back and bring up the next member with them.
zh: 希望他们也能回过头来，把下一位成员一起带上来。

en: This is how we move forward and this is how we create long-standing joy.
zh: 这就是我们向前走的方式，也就是我们创造长久快乐的方式。

en: The second axis here is representation and also responsibility.
zh: 这里的第二条轴线，是代表性，也同样是责任。

en: So success is, again, inseparable from responsibility.
zh: 所以，成功同样离不开责任。

en: When you have a platform, I implore you to use it meaningfully,
zh: 当你拥有一个平台时，我恳请你有意义地使用它，

en: to make the world better.
zh: 让这个世界变得更好。

en: in whatever way you think is most valuable and relevant to you.
zh: 用任何你认为最有价值、也与你最相关的方式。

en: And only then, only then, when we have those two axes, responsibility and gratitude,
zh: 只有到那时，只有到那时，当我们拥有这两条轴线，责任和感恩，

en: can we uplift one another.
zh: 我们才能彼此托举。

en: And so I want to thank everybody here tonight.
zh: 所以，我想感谢今晚在座的每一个人。

en: I want to thank Gold House Gala.
zh: 我想感谢 Gold House Gala。

en: I want to thank all the other honorees who are so inspiring and so incredible.
zh: 我想感谢所有其他获奖者，你们如此鼓舞人心，如此了不起。

en: And lastly, to everyone here tonight.
zh: 最后，我想感谢今晚在座的每一个人。

en: who has brought me so much joy that I literally came up with this new theory sitting at this table.
zh: 你们带给我的快乐太多了，以至于我坐在这张桌子旁，真的想出了这个新理论。

en: And so thank you all for being part of this community.
zh: 所以，谢谢你们所有人成为这个社群的一部分。

en: Thank you so much for this evening.
zh: 非常感谢你们成就了今晚。

en: and for all the love that you show one another.
zh: 也感谢你们彼此展现出的所有爱。

en: tonight and every night.
zh: 无论是今晚，还是每一个夜晚。

en: Let's keep going.
zh: 让我们继续前进。

en: Let's keep getting better.
zh: 让我们继续变得更好。

en: Let's keep showing the world what we're made of and taking up center stage.
zh: 让我们继续向世界展示我们的力量，继续站上舞台中央。

en: So thank you so much.
zh: 所以，非常感谢大家。
